title: Hazara genocide
text: The Hazara genocide occurred in the Hazaristan area of contemporary Afghanistan in the aftermath of the Second Anglo-Afghan War, when the Emirate of Afghanistan signed the Treaty of Gandamak. The Afghan emir, Abdur Rahman Khan set out to bring the Turkistan, Hazaristan, and Kafiristan regions under Afghan control. He launched several campaigns in the Hazarajat due to resistance to oppression from the Hazaras, culminating in the Battle of Uruzgan and he conducted a widespread genocidal campaign against its population.
